pieces.Text: As a standard action, a sandman can cause its humanoid form to collapse into a pile of animated sand.  In this form, treat the sandman as if it were a Small earth elemental made out of sand.  The sandman retains its compression and sleep aura abilities when in sand form, but loses its sleep attack and its damage reduction, as its sandy body in this form is much more compact and easier to scatter with solid blows.
